lines.text: Rush hour traffic sits bumper to bumper across @bridge_dusk.
@sai_front pedals into frame, helmet on, steady and quick.
He weaves between stopped cars, brake lights glowing red.
Drivers drum their steering wheels, going nowhere.
He glides clear of the jam toward the open end.
City lights flicker on as he rides into the evening.

writes.note: I drafted a short, visual 15-second scene from your line: one location, seven beats, no dialogue.

reply.rationale: Kept the person's idea (cycling past stopped cars, smiling) as a one-location scene with seven short beats of about 14 s and no dialogue. Used only the references given, @sai_front and @bridge_dusk.
